bull.b: Revenue growth and expanding center adoption show the platform is moving from development toward repeatable commercialization. A larger active-site base and 63-center funnel can support future procedure volumes, although conversion still needs to occur.

An approximately 84% gross margin, consistent with Q1, indicates favorable economics on current RenovaCath utilization. If repeat orders and center activation continue, this margin profile could provide operating leverage as fixed commercial costs are spread over higher revenue.

Phase 3 TIGeR-PaC is fully enrolled, with 78 of 86 required events observed, while peer-reviewed publications and PK work support targeted delivery. Completing the trial could strengthen clinical credibility and broaden adoption of the TAMP platform.

bear.b: RNXT remains deeply unprofitable: TTM net margin is about -622%, net loss was approximately $12.3M, and Q2 operating loss was $3.4M. The scale of losses relative to revenue means commercialization has not yet produced sustainable earnings.

bear.t: Negative cash flow and financing dependence
bear.b: Operating and free cash flow were about -$11.9M TTM, while cash fell from $12.4M to $9.5M in Q2. Continued development and commercialization therefore require the company to preserve runway and may require external capital before self-funding.

Management's breakeven target requires roughly $5M in quarterly revenue by Q4 2027, relying on rapid conversion of pipeline and trial sites. Delayed activations or repeat usage could postpone breakeven and weaken the planned cash runway.
